record_title: Sharp small-regularization conditioning of the QOT dual linearization
provenance: Spectral analysis of the QOT dual optimizer linearization using the sharp support geometry and local Markov-kernel estimates of arXiv:2609.20400.
limitations: Continuous smooth marginals, quadratic cost, and sufficiently small epsilon are required. The theorem is local to the optimizer linearization and does not establish global nonlinear convergence for the larger local step scale. Semi-discrete transport, rough marginals, general costs, discretization, and finite precision are not covered. The companion Geometry and Convergence of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport II is cited as a 2026 working paper but was not available for inspection and may contain overlapping consequences; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
